commercial.locked.title: Commercial Feature
commercial.notice.upgrade: This installation runs {current}. Upgrade to {tier} to use this feature.
commercial.feature.auditLog.description: Query and audit login logs, operation logs and SMS logs.
commercial.feature.workflow.description: Flowable-based content approval workflow: process model design, process instance management and history.
commercial.feature.articleReview.descrip: Article submission review with pass/reject handling, integrated with the approval workflow.
commercial.feature.dataMigration.descrip: Migrate channel and article data from another system's database via SQL, keeping the old-to-new ID mapping; requires ujcms.data-migration-enabled in the configuration.
commercial.feature.securitySettings.desc: Password strength and expiry policies, login-failure lockout, and a one-click MLPS Level 3 recommended policy.
commercial.feature.docImport.description: Import Word documents into the article editor (converted to HTML) and convert documents in the media library.
commercial.feature.articleImport.descrip: Import articles in bulk from an Excel sheet: a dry run shows which rows can be imported and what is wrong with the others, then a background task creates the articles as drafts and reports the result.
commercial.feature.recommend.description: Personalized article recommendations in the member center, scored by browsing history, favorites and followed tags, channels and authors; falls back to the site's weekly top articles for anonymous visitors or when there is no signal.
commercial.feature.nationalDatabase.desc: Support for Chinese domestic databases such as Dameng, Kingbase, Highgo and Shentong.
commercial.feature.internalPush.descript: Push articles to other sites within this system.
commercial.feature.aiProvider.descriptio: LLM provider and MT engine configuration, connectivity tests, daily quotas and the AI usage log; the shared foundation of AI translation and the AI editorial assistant.
commercial.feature.aiAssist.description: AI writing aids (continue/expand/polish), SEO metadata generation, risk screening and message-board reply drafts.
commercial.feature.aiModeration.descript: Automatic AI moderation of submitted UGC (comments and message-board posts) with a human review queue.
commercial.feature.articleTranslation.de: One click creates a linked draft translation in a language-group peer site (copies content, targets the same-slug channel, joins the translation group); linked drafts can be pre-translated by an LLM provider or an MT engine.
commercial.feature.articleTranslationBat: Batch-processes articles the target language site is missing: links an unlinked same-slug/same-title article in the target channel, otherwise creates a linked draft and pre-translates it (MT engine or LLM; drafts-only mode available); runs as a background task with stop support and a per-article report.
commercial.feature.channelTranslationBat: Run on the source-language site, syncs channels into a language-group target site: missing same-slug channels are created the way site creation copies them, and created channels plus names, SEO fields and bodies still identical to this site's are translated into the target language (LLM or MT engine; create-only mode available); hand-edited values are never overwritten, safe to re-run.
commercial.feature.survey.description: Survey design, publishing and result statistics.
commercial.feature.multiSite.description: Create, copy and manage multiple sites (site groups).
commercial.feature.themeSandbox.descript: One-click sandbox site with demo data for evaluating a candidate theme; discard or adopt after browsing.
commercial.feature.greyMode.description: Site-wide grey display mode for memorial days.
commercial.feature.sensitiveWord.descrip: Sensitive word management and content detection.
commercial.feature.errorWord.description: Error-prone word management and content correction.
commercial.feature.editorSettings.descri: Site-level rich-text editor typesetting settings (font, size, line height, indent, image/table alignment), one-click typesetting and the format painter.
commercial.feature.collection.descriptio: Collect and import content from external sources.
commercial.feature.customForm.descriptio: Custom form design, submission and review.
commercial.feature.topic.description: Tree-structured topics with article bindings: topic and topic-list pages, topic templates and custom models, view statistics.
commercial.feature.backup.description: Template backup, uploads backup, incremental uploads backup and database backup.
commercial.feature.articleStat.descripti: Article statistics by user, organization and channel.
commercial.feature.oauthLogin.descriptio: OAuth login via WeChat, Weibo and other providers.
commercial.feature.scheduleTask.descript: Periodic scheduling (Quartz) of static page updates, full-text index builds, timed collection, template / upload / database backups and other jobs.
commercial.feature.wechat.description: Official account management: accounts, media, drafts, publishing, menus, followers, tags, auto-replies, messages, article push, QR codes, template messages, statistics and mass sending.
commercial.feature.visualBuilder.descrip: Edit region structure WYSIWYG on the rendered page: drag-and-drop panels, the component catalog, draft / publish / history and composition diagnostics.
commercial.feature.systemMonitor.descrip: Real-time monitoring of CPU, memory and disk load.
commercial.feature.performance.descripti: Performance type definition and statistics by user and organization.
commercial.feature.advancedReview.descri: Back, delegate and transfer operations for article/form review, plus multi-instance approval.
commercial.feature.elasticsearch.descrip: Full-text search backed by Elasticsearch instead of Lucene, with Redis distributed caching for clustered deployments.
commercial.feature.disclosure.descriptio: Government information disclosure on request: application intake, processing and replies.
commercial.feature.mailbox.description: Government leader's mailbox: letter intake, processing, replies and statistics.
commercial.feature.interview.description: Government online interviews: announcements, question collection and live text-and-image coverage.
commercial.feature.census.description: Government website census: census tasks, issue lists and remediation reports.
Accessibility and senior-friendly browsing toolbar (EaseBar) for government sites: care mode, speech reading, high-contrast schemes, page zoom, large cursor, reading guide, big captions, text-only mode and landmark jumps.
